exceptions.rationale: No compatible patched update through the current stable SSH dependency. The inspected service uses ssh-key RSA public signature verification and private-key parsing, pins gateway JWT verification to Ed25519, and delegates KMS private operations upstream. No local RustCrypto RSA private-decryption call was identified. Keep RSA SSH verification; reassess changes to crypto call paths or features. See docs/security-evidence.md.

The advisory concerns timing-dependent arithmetic on secret integers. The inspected production paths use the affected curve stack for public SSH certificate verification only. OpenSSH ECDSA private-key decoding copies encoded scalar bytes and supplied public coordinates without deriving a public key or invoking big-integer arithmetic; DER/PKCS8 parsing uses AWS-LC. JWT verification accepts Ed25519 only. No affected production arithmetic on secret integers was identified. crypto-bigint 0.7.6 is patched, but ssh-key 0.6.7 remains the latest stable release and requires the older curve stack. Retain supported SSH verification and stable dependencies; reassess on changes to local signing, key generation, crypto features, consumers, or expiry. See docs/security-evidence.md and https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2026-0387.html.
